name: Jozabad
overview: Jozabad was a male Levite known for his role in explaining the law to the people, as recorded in Nehemiah 8:7. His contribution was significant in helping the community understand God's commandments during a pivotal moment of spiritual renewal. No additional personal notes are provided.
namesAndTitles: The name Jozabad means 'YHWH bestowed,' reflecting a divine gift or blessing. This proper name underscores the biblical theme of God's provision and favor, as noted in Nehemiah 8:7.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly identifies Jozabad as a descendant of Levi, linking him to the priestly tribe entrusted with religious duties. No other family relationships beyond this tribal affiliation are recorded.
scriptureSignificance: Jozabad's importance lies in his role as a teacher of the law, facilitating the people's understanding of God's word during the restoration period described in Nehemiah. His work exemplifies faithful service within the Levitical tradition, emphasizing the necessity of clear instruction in God's statutes for the spiritual health of Israel.
